outcome: psychometric properties of the Icelandic City Birth Trauma Scale (City BiTS)
prevalence of childbirth-related post-traumatic stress symptoms
prevalence of childbirth-related post-traumatic stress disorder
cohort: The study included 616 Icelandic mothers who were 6-12 weeks postpartum.
finding: The Icelandic version of City BiTS showed good psychometric properties with a two-factor model, and the study found that 15.6% of women experienced traumatic birth and 2.4% met criteria for childbirth-related PTSD.
